title: Worker Capsule
description: Codex Factory V4.2 — Self-contained worker assignment capsule for manual/local/agent execution

assigned_tasks.description: Task IDs assigned to this worker

allowed_files.description: File patterns this worker may modify (e.g. src/backend/, tests/backend/)

forbidden_files.description: File patterns this worker MUST NOT touch (e.g. src/*/auth*, config/secrets*)

input_artifacts.description: Artifacts this worker may consume as input

required_output_artifacts.description: Artifacts this worker MUST produce before handoff

validation_methods.description: Validation methods applicable to this worker's tasks

related_skill_packs.description: Skill packs relevant to this worker's tasks

related_knowledge_sources.description: Knowledge sources referenced by this worker's tasks

handoff_required.description: Whether this worker must produce a handoff file

completion_criteria.description: Criteria that must be met before this worker is considered complete

forbidden_actions.description: Actions this worker MUST NOT perform

default: Worker output is not final acceptance
